headline: His communication, follow-through, and marketing knowledge are second to none
quote: Ben is my go-to for messaging and positioning work. I mentor a lot of founders and startups and he has consistently helped them refine their messaging to use across a variety of channels. He also helped me create the messaging for my website and has taught lessons for Amelia Network. His communication, follow-through, and marketing knowledge are second to none and perfect for my clients who are looking for a partner that understands speed with quality is good for their business.
name: Chris Manderino
